note: Spike 0 part A: environment report, pinned toolchain installs, Go+Rust hello-worlds, repo reachability. Thresholds pre-registered in spikes/spike0-compute/RESULTS.md.

commands.name: hello-go
commands.run:
mkdir -p /tmp/hello-go && cd /tmp/hello-go && printf 'package main
import "fmt"
func main(){ fmt.Println("go-hybrid spike0: go hello OK") }
' > main.go && PATH=/tmp/go/bin:$PATH go mod init hello >/dev/null 2>&1; cd /tmp/hello-go && PATH=/tmp/go/bin:$PATH go build -o hello . && ./hello

commands.name: hello-rust
commands.run: export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH && cargo new --bin --vcs none /tmp/hello-rust 2>/dev/null; cd /tmp/hello-rust && cargo build --quiet --target-dir /tmp/hello-rust/target 2>&1 | tail -3; /tmp/hello-rust/target/debug/hello-rust

commands.name: repo-check
commands.run: ls -la SPEC.md AGENTS.md PLAN.md && git log -1 --oneline
